properties.table_content:
| Category          | Financing Source/Type                      | Amount ($bn) |
|-------------------|--------------------------------------------|--------------|
| Cash Need         | Global Capex on Data Centers (ex. Power)   | 2,900        |
| Financing Path    | Hyperscaler Capex Funded with Cash Flows   | 1,400        |
|                   | Corporate Debt                             | 200          |
|                   | ABS & CMBS                                 | 150          |
|                   | Private Credit Opportunity                 | 800          |
|                   | Other Capital (PE, VC, Sovereign)          | 350          |
properties.key_insight: Of the $2.9tr projected data center capex through 2028, $1.4tr will be funded internally and $1.5tr externally, with an $800bn private credit opportunity.
